data.body:
Move-In/Out

Purpose

This component enables you to process a customer move-in or move-out. In the case of a move-in, you can create a business partner and contract account for the customer, or select existing ones. The contracts are then created and allocated to a utility installation.

In a move-out, you terminate the customer's contract. If a new customer moves into the installation, the installation is allocated to this customer's contract.

For more information, see Move-In and Move-Out.

Integration

Letters to the customer, such as welcome letters and move-out confirmations are created using the Print Workbench component. The SAP Business Workflow component (BC-BMT-WFM) enables you to monitor and configure the workflow processes.

Features

You can have the system trigger a number of activities automatically. You can:

  • process the entire transaction immediately and in full.

  • create a final bill for the move-out customer.

  • create a welcome letter for the move-in customer.

You can also configure the screen layout to suit your requirements.
